name: gameboy-pokemon-theme
description: A minimal, retro handheld-inspired light theme with Deep Crimson chassis framing and Pikachu Gold accents.

scripts.validate: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const pkg=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8')); const theme=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('themes/gameboy-pokemon-color-theme.json','utf8')); const contribution=pkg.contributes.themes[0]; if (contribution.label !== 'Game Boy Pokémon Light' || contribution.uiTheme !== 'vs' || contribution.path !== './themes/gameboy-pokemon-color-theme.json' || theme.type !== 'light') process.exit(1); console.log('Publish manifest and theme JSON are valid.');"
